name: classes-rs-m15-medium
description: The Rust counterpart of classes-v15 on the medium starts: borg-rs v15R (tag 4.2.6-impact-v15, 137 carries, Angband 574b618c) on classes-1800-medium (starts 91-360) under normal (modes off). borg-rs removed the munchkin and lunal modes (borg-rs#60): a profile that turns one on is refused at start-up, as rs-m15-smoke's munchkin-class arm showed (18 of 18 stopped at turn 1). Compare start by start with classes-v15 (better-borg-c M15, the same game commit): identical play hashes show the port reproduces C; differences are listed.
owner_authorization: 2026-11-20: the owner asked to "file a medium suite for borg-rs last milestone / relase" (borg-zoo#463). Dispatched after rs-m15-smoke passes its gate.
